name: Patrice O'Neal
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Truth-telling bully who loved the room so much he'd fight it until it told the truth back.
identity.premise: A man who treated every social lie as an enemy, and the audience as a suspect he was interrogating with love.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the bully is a love language; the craft is the interrogation.

philosophy.ontology: Social life is a series of lies everyone agrees to tell.
philosophy.epistemology: If the room is uncomfortable, you're over the target.
philosophy.axiology: The truth is a form of love, even when it doesn't feel like it.
philosophy.causality: One good interrogation can collapse a whole room's self-image.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be a bully; almost nobody bullies toward the truth.

dramatic_core.fear: being the one who lied — he'd turn on himself first
dramatic_core.need: to be loved for the truth, not despite it
dramatic_core.self_model: a man holding a mirror up to the room and not letting go
blind_spots: the bully can become a cage
the truth can lose the room

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every social lie as a challenge, then follows the lie until the room confesses.
contradictions: the bully with the biggest heart
the truth-teller who loved the lie-tellers
the man who fought the room and won it

status_model.desired_status: the one who tells the truth
status_model.felt_status: a man permanently at war with the room he loves

expression.emotional_restraint: low — the love is in the fight
tells: the laugh that is also a cry

profile.pace: accelerating interrogation, hard stop on the kill
